ambient_life: Butterflies (white and lemon) over the garden flowers, 10-14 instances
Chimney smoke from Jack's cottage, slow soft puffs drifting east
Swallows circling the stalk in two loops (y 10-18 and y 30-38), radius 9-12 m
Falling leaves shed from the stalk, 1 every 2 s, spiralling down to the garden
Pollen motes around the Bluebell Hive and the sunflower
Drifting cloud wisps moving east at 0.6 m/s on both cloud layers
Cloud sea far below (y -24) rolling slowly; distant cloud mountains on a 180 m ring
Wolf banners on the castle flapping; the belfry bell sways gently
The sleeping Giant: chest rises and falls, nightcap pom-pom bobs, snore Zs and crumbs fly on each snore
Steam curl from the teacup; the pocket-watch hand ticks around
Bees (ambient, harmless, tiny) around the sunflower, separate from the Bumble Bruisers
Daisy the cow grazing in the garden, flicks tail, moos when Mak passes

truffles.title: Up the Beanstalk
steps: Spawn at Default; follow the dirt path north past Daisy the cow to the stalk
Climb leaves L01-L05, then hop quickly across the droopy leaves L06-L08 before they sag (or backflip from L03 onto the Knot Shelf K1 and jump to Vine 1)
Jump onto Vine 1, climb to the top, hop onto L09
Hop to Bouncy Leaf 1; the bounce carries you onto the Sunleaf (checkpoint)
L12 and L13, then step onto the Cloud Landing
Walk to the lookout pillow on the Landing's north-west tip
enemies: Peapod Poppers PG1/PG2 (near the path, optional)
Crow Bandit E04 at the Sunleaf
truffles.pass_test: From Default, a replay reaches C1 with y >= 23.9 inside 110 s using single jumps, vine climb and the bounce, spending <= 0.6 s on each droopy leaf; Game.has_truffle('W2-1') is true after touching the pillow. A second replay takes the K1 backflip shortcut and reaches Vine 1 without touching L04-L08. Waiting on a sagged leaf never needs more than a double jump (worst rise 2.0 m).

truffles.title: Free the Golden Goose
truffles.reveal: laid by the real Golden Goose when Mak lifts the tea cosy on the hearth (after the goose-costume wolf is beaten)
steps: Reach the castle bank and enter the gate; the cage holds a 'goose' that honks badly
S1: from the south wall-walk, backflip onto the gatehouse roof (3.4 m) and Ham Slam S1
S2: in the kitchen, double-jump up dresser shelves A, B, C (or jump from the table's north edge to C) and Ham Slam S2
S3: on the north wall-walk, climb the Giant's broom to the NE turret top and Ham Slam S3
Each switch visibly breaks the disguise (any order): a wolf ear pops out ('HONK.'), then a bushy tail ('Hhhonk?'), then the hood slips over its eyes ('...baa?')

The cage opens, the portcullis drops and the half-dressed wolf (E16) waddles off round the courtyard. Run behind it on a straight and dive-tackle it (or jump-kick it, or punch it while it is dazed against the portcullis). Two hits: hood off, then suit off; it spins out of the gate in its underwear
The tea cosy on the kitchen hearth honks. Sniff leads there. Punch the cosy: the real Golden Goose wakes and lays the truffle
enemies: Woolly Wolf in a goose costume E16 (waddle-flee chase)
Crow Bandit E14 heckles from the SE spire during the chase; E15 stays on the west wall-walk
truffles.pass_test: Teleport to Spawns/W2-2. Each ham_slam on S1-S3 advances the cage's costume stage by one (ear, tail, hood) with its line, in any order; the third opens the cage within 2 s, drops the portcullis and starts E16 on the oval at 5.5 m/s. A scripted straight run (6.8 m/s or more) plus a dive that touches E16 registers hit 1; a jump kick registers hit 2; E16 then exits through the gate, w2_goose_wolf is set and the portcullis lifts within 2 s. A punch on a running E16 does not count; a punch while it is dazed at the portcullis does. Contact never damages Mak. E16's path never enters x > 16.6 (stairs) or the kitchen arch. Hitting TEA_COSY afterwards spawns Truffle W2-2 at (-13, 50, -39.6) +/- 0.5 m within 3 s; before that it gives a sleepy honk. S1 is reachable by a standing backflip from the wall-walk (replay). A human tester ends the chase in 60 s or less.

truffles.title: Fee-Fi-Fo-Hum
truffles.reveal: always visible, on the Giant's nightcap pom-pom
steps: Inside the kitchen: sugar sack, crate, cookbook stack, chair seat (checkpoint CP6), table top
Cross the table west. The breath cycle is inhale 2.0 s (pull west toward the nose), hold 0.5 s, snore blast 1.6 s (push east), rest 1.2 s
During blasts hide on the east side of the watch, teacup and loaf (H3)
Step round to the loaf's west side (H3b) and wait there through the inhale; idling in the open nose zone gets Mak SNEEZED: a 2 s arc over the table back onto the chair cushion ('...bless me...')
In the 1.2 s rest after a blast, step from H3b onto the beard (its edge touches the H3b box; 1.4 m centre to centre, one short hop): it bounces Mak onto the nightcap pom-pom and the truffle
The Giant mutters 'Nngh... smells like... bacon?' and sleeps on
objects: WALL_SCREEN_W, WALL_SCREEN_N and WALL_SCREEN_B1 (block the wall-walk skips)
CANDLE (its flame shows the breath phase)
enemies: none; the Giant's breath is the hazard
truffles.pass_test: Teleport to CP6. A scripted run that waits in the H3 lee boxes during blasts and in H3b during inhales, then hits BEARD in a rest phase, lands on POMPOM and collects W2-3 in <= 45 s. Standing idle 2 s in H2b during an inhale triggers the sneeze: Mak follows the scripted 2.0 s arc and lands on CHAIR at CP6 (4, 54.4, -34) +/- 0.5 m, health unchanged, touching no collider on the way; the first sneeze per save collects A41 (5). Standing in the open during a blast pushes Mak >= 6 m east. Landing on BEARD during an inhale also sneezes Mak back. CANDLE adds no route: its holder top (56.0) is 3.6 m below POMPOM. Skip check (r2): no walkable surface other than BEARD lies within 3.5 m horizontally and up to 2.5 m below POMPOM's top (59.6); a reach check over every walkable top (running jump 2.43, double 3.54, backflip 3.75 m apex at 7.5 m/s; long jump 6.7 m) finds no route to POMPOM from the west or north wall-walk, B1, SHELF_TOP, TEACUP, LOAF, SUGAR or BUTTER. The only other routes are the table triple jump and the B2 drop, both allowed.

truffles.title: The Harpnapper
truffles.reveal: played out by the Golden Harp on the Blossom Islet when Captain Caw (E17) is beaten
steps: On the Upper Cloudbank's west rim, Captain Caw taunts Mak with a singing sack ('I am being HARPNAPPED!') and flies to PERCH1 over LB2
Long-jump from the west rim onto LB1 (4.6 m, 0.6 m drop) and bounce to LB2

Bounce in place on the swinging LB2: Caw rides along above it, his loot sack (the harp peeking out) hanging at the top of your bounce. Jump-kick the sack at the apex (hit 1, 3 acorns); he flees to PERCH2 over LB4
Bounce LB2 -> LB3 -> LB4 through the crosswind and kick the sack again at the top of an LB4 bounce (hit 2)
Bounce LB5 to the Blossom Islet. Caw sulks in the blossom tree: Ham Slam the islet next to the trunk to shake him down, then punch or kick him (hit 3)
The sack bursts; the Golden Harp sings 'At last, an audience!' and plays the truffle out. Exit by the Launch Leaf to the castle bank
truffles.pass_test: From Spawns/W2-4: E17 taunts and moves to PERCH1 (y 49.6) and tracks LB2's swing within 0.15 s; a scripted jump_kick at the top of an LB2 bounce that touches the sack sphere (r 1.3, centre y 48.8) registers hit 1 from any swing phase (sample 8 phases); the same at LB4 (centre 49.8) registers hit 2; a ham_slam on ISLET within 2.0 m of BLOSSOM_TREE drops E17 dizzy for 2.5 s; a punch then spawns W2-4 at (-40.5, 46, -38) +/- 0.5 m within 3 s. Caw does not drift while Mak is mid-bounce. Body contact without an attack never damages Mak. After a fall Mak respawns on CP4 with no enemy within 7 m (E13 now patrols the Upper Runner), and E17 waits at the last perch reached. A human tester finishes in 3 attempts or fewer. The round 1 gap checks still hold (3.64-4.16 m).

steps: P1 Root Ledge under the north-west rim (drop off the edge where the acorn line points; climb Vine 0 back)
P2 on the cottage chimney cap (water butt, woodpile, eave, thatch, chimney)

truffles.title: Pea Pod Patrol
truffles.reveal: spawned when E05-E09 are all defeated
steps: Ride the Beanpod Lift from the garden (or walk the pea-vine bridge from the Cloud Landing)
Five Peapod Poppers (E05-E09) lob 2 volleys, then burrow and resurface at another of the 13 mounds, set in lanes of three (they prefer a lane that already holds a pod)
Snout Sniff shows a wisp to each occupied mound. Ham Slam beside one: the shockwave runs down its lane and every pod in it pops up stunned for 2.5 s, lying across the lane like skittles
Belly-slide down the lane: 2 pods = SPARE! (+4 acorns), 3 pods = STRIKE! (+10 acorns, the scarecrow wails 'Not the peas!'). A kick also defeats a stunned pod
After the third pod the scarecrow shouts 'Reinforcements!' and Bumble Bruisers E11 and E12 start charging
The fifth pod pops the truffle out of the soil in front of the scarecrow
objects: pod mounds PM01-PM13 in lanes R1-R5
truffles.pass_test: With --mission=W2-6: E05-E09 burrow after 2 volleys and resurface only at PM01-PM13; a ham_slam within 1.6 m of an occupied mound stuns every pod in that lane for 2.5 s; a scripted slam plus slide defeats three pods in one lane and shows STRIKE (seed the resurface RNG so three pods share lane R2); a slide hit on a stunned pod defeats it; E11/E12 stay passive until 3 pods are defeated; defeating E05-E09 spawns Truffle W2-6 at (24, 24, 0.5) +/- 0.5 m within 2 s. The 5 popper nodes share group 'w2_pod_patrol'. No mound lies within 1.0 m of the z -4.5 triple-jump lane (x 25.3..34.5) or inside a cabbage.

truffles.title: Cloud Hopper
truffles.reveal: spawned on the Cloud Gong when all 6 rings are passed inside the time limit (start at 34 s, set to measured clean run + 30%)
steps: Touch the start pad west of the Cloud Landing: 6 golden rings light up and the page-turn timer starts
Bounce PUFF01-PUFF03 (2.6 m rises) through R1 and R2
Chain jump, double jump, triple jump across the flat puffs PUFF04-PUFF06 (they vanish 0.25 s after landing) and thread R3 at the triple's peak
Rest on PUFF07, then long-jump east to PUFF08, threading R4 low in the gap
Bounce PUFF08-PUFF10 up through R5 to the diving-board puff PUFF11
Dive east through R6 onto the Upper Cloudbank and belly-slide into the Cloud Gong
truffles.pass_test: A replay of the intended route (jump, double, triple, long jump, dive) passes all 6 rings. Two R3 replays, one taking off from the near half of PUFF06 and one from the far half, both pass R3 (r3: centre y 37.1, r 1.0) with at least 0.3 m to spare, and a running double from PUFF06 misses it. The timer is then set to the measured time + 30% (34 s until measured). A single jump from PUFF06 cannot reach PUFF07 (4.15 m < 4.4 m gap). Missing a ring or timing out resets the rings and re-arms the pad. No enemy crosses the Cloud Hopper or the Upper Cloudbank (E13 is on the Upper Runner).

truffles.title: Top of the Stalk
truffles.reveal: inside the closed bean-flower bud on the belfry top; the bud opens when Mak Ham Slams the bell's crown plate. Snout Sniff draws the trail up the vine, onto the bell and up the gallery
steps: From CP7 by the stalk's foot on the castle bank, jump from the bank's south rim to the stalk-tip vine V3 and climb to its top
Jump onto the tip leaf T3
The Giant's bell swings east-west under the beanstalk's hook (4 s). When it swings east, hop onto its crown plate

Ham Slam the crown plate: BONG. The first time per save, a two-shot cutaway shows the ring wave cross the castle and the Giant jolt awake ('FEE! FI! FO!... bacon?') and nod off again; the bean-flower bud on the belfry top bursts open. Later slams just ring (1 s, no input lock)
Ride the bell west and jump to the B2 gallery spur (double jump, or jump plus ledge grab)
Jump and grab up to the belfry top (68), step onto the open flower's heart and take the truffle

The flower bursts into bean seeds. Mak grabs one and rides it on a 12 s spiral down the whole world (castle, Cloud Gong, Allotment, through the lower cloud layer, over the cottage) and lands at the garden gate, where Jack and Daisy cheer
enemies: none on the climb; crow E15 stays on the west wall-walk
truffles.pass_test: From CP7 a replay climbs V3, boards BELL at its east extreme, slams the plate (the flower opens), leaves at the west extreme for BELL_GALLERY and collects W2-8. Check: no walkable surface at y >= 64 lies within 9 m of the belfry centre except BELL's plate, BELL_GALLERY, B2 and the belfry top; the stalk above 62.5 has no collision. The first slam per save plays the BONG cutaway on StoryCam_E_v3 (3.2 s, input locked, skippable with jump after 1.0 s) and Mak is still on the plate afterwards; later slams and later visits play the 1 s in-world beat with no input lock. After the truffle fanfare the seed descent runs: Mak follows seed_descent_r3.waypoints in 12.0 s +/- 0.5 (skippable with jump after 1.5 s, which cuts to the landing), stays at least 1.5 m from every collider except the start flower and the landing ground, and ends standing at CP0 (0, 0, 31) with CP0 active. The descent never plays for any other truffle.

build_order: 1. WorldRoot scene res://scenes/worlds/w2/W2.tscn (world_id W2, display_name 'Beanstalk Skyway', music_key w2_beanstalk, kill_y -15). Add WorldEnvironment, sun, fog and sky from LIGHTING.
2. Garden island: heightfield mesh from TERRAIN.island + paths + roots; underside cone; trimesh collision for the top only.
3. Beanstalk: sweep 3 twisted tubes along TERRAIN.stalk.spline; capsule-chain collision (one capsule per spline segment).
4. Platforms from data/levels/W2.json 'platforms' (leaves, clouds, boxes, discs) in zone order Z0..Z6; leaves face rot_y, stems are visual only.

5. Castle: bank (ellipse + core box), curtain walls (4 boxes, 2 m thick, 8 m high, gate and partition arches as gaps), wall-walk tops, turrets, belfry (cylinder r 5 to 68), balconies B1/B2 (ring meshes, B2 notch), buttress slot walls (two 0.8 x 3.0 x 8 m boxes at x -19.9 and -16.1, z -19.5..-16.5, y 58..66), merlons.
6. Kitchen: table, legs, chair, pantry steps, dresser shelves, table objects; then the Giant visual and H2/H3 zones.
7. Moving and special: Beanpod Lift (AnimatableBody3D), bouncy leaves (group 'bouncy', meta bounce_velocity), puff clouds, broom and vines (group 'climbable'), watch hand.
8. Gameplay nodes: Spawns, StoryCams (never move later), Checkpoints, Truffles + spawners, Switches + GooseCage, LostPages + LostPageSet, AcornGroups + AcornHundred, enemies.
9. Visual cloud layers CL1/CL2, cloud sea, props zones, ambient life, local lights.
10. Verify: python tools/godot.py capture for each StoryCam; walk the main route with a replay; run the pass tests below.
